script.spoken: Comair 5191 failed because take-off from a short. It crashed into trees, and forty nine people were killed. It had lined up on the wrong runway. That runway was short and unlit. Construction had changed the usual taxi route. Neither pilot noticed the heading didn't match. The jet couldn't lift off in time. Runway-confirmation checks were strengthened afterward.
